---
title: "Analysis of brain data"
author: "Katie Yip"
editor: visual
---

**Aim:**

summarise and calculate total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the **forebrain**

Sum of genes expressed in a elevated manner in the **cerebral cortex**:

```{r}
human_elevated_cerebralcortex <- 180
pig_elevated_cerebralcortex <- 109
mouse_elevated_cerebralcortex <- 55
total_elevated_cerebralcortex <- sum(human_elevated_cerebralcortex + pig_elevated_cerebralcortex + mouse_elevated_cerebralcortex)
print(total_elevated_cerebralcortex)
```

Sum of genes expressed in a elevated manner in the **basal ganglia**:

```{r}
human_elevated_basalganglia <- 83
pig_elevated_basalganglia <- 157
mouse_elevated_basalganglia <- 185
total_elevated_basalganglia <- sum(human_elevated_basalganglia + pig_elevated_basalganglia + mouse_elevated_basalganglia)
print(total_elevated_basalganglia)
```

Sum of genes expressed in a elevated manner in the **thalamus**:

```{r}
human_elevated_thalamus <- 57
pig_elevated_thalamus <- 31
mouse_elevated_thalamus <- 60
total_elevated_thalamus <- sum(human_elevated_thalamus + pig_elevated_thalamus + mouse_elevated_thalamus)
print(total_elevated_thalamus)
```

Sum of genes expressed in a elevated manner in the **hypothalamus**:

```{r}
human_elevated_hypothalamus <- 110
pig_elevated_hypothalamus <- 45
mouse_elevated_hypothalamus <- 98
total_elevated_hypothalamus <- sum(human_elevated_hypothalamus + pig_elevated_hypothalamus + mouse_elevated_hypothalamus)
print(total_elevated_hypothalamus)
```

Sum of total upregulated genes in the forebrain:

```{r}
total_upregulatedgenes <- sum(total_elevated_hypothalamus + total_elevated_thalamus + total_elevated_basalganglia +total_elevated_cerebralcortex)
print(paste("The total number of upregulated genes in the forebrain in all 3 species is" , total_upregulatedgenes ))
```

Sum of total upregulated genes in the forebrain of humans:

```{r}
total_humanupregulatedgenes <- sum(human_elevated_hypothalamus + human_elevated_thalamus + human_elevated_basalganglia +human_elevated_cerebralcortex)
print(paste("The total number of upregulated genes in the forebrain in humans is" , total_humanupregulatedgenes ))
```

Sum of total upregulated genes in the forebrain of pigs:

```{r}
total_pigupregulatedgenes <- sum(pig_elevated_hypothalamus + pig_elevated_thalamus + pig_elevated_basalganglia + pig_elevated_cerebralcortex)
print(paste("The total number of upregulated genes in the forebrain in pig is" , total_pigupregulatedgenes ))
```

Sum of total upregulated genes in the forebrain of mouse:

```{r}
total_mouseupregulatedgenes <- sum(mouse_elevated_hypothalamus + mouse_elevated_thalamus + mouse_elevated_basalganglia +mouse_elevated_cerebralcortex)
print(paste("The total number of upregulated genes in the forebrain in mouse is" , total_mouseupregulatedgenes ))
```

The highest number of upregulated genes is in humans with 430 genes

## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
